name: Kha'Zix
notes: Kha'Zix opens by casting Void Assault (R) at t=0 purely for its Unseen Threat proc (R deals no direct damage): stealth ends at 1.25 s, the free recast becomes available 2 s later, so the recast fires immediately at 3.25 s for a second Unseen Threat proc; R's own cooldown (70-100 s) is far too long for a third activation inside a 15 s fight.
The dummy has no allies, minions or turrets nearby for the whole fight, so it is treated as Isolated the entire time: Taste Their Fear always deals its 210% (2.1x) damage tier.

Evolved Reaper Claws (evolving Q) is assumed to be the evolution chosen with one of the three evolution points available by level 16, since it is the only evolution that raises single-target damage here (via the Isolated-target 45% cooldown reduction); evolving W or E instead would give no additional damage against a single stationary target, so their choice does not change these numbers.

Q, W and E are each cast as soon as they come off cooldown; W's extra clusters and E's range/reset bonuses only exist on their own (unchosen) evolutions, so neither has an isolation-conditional damage bonus here.
Unseen Threat's bonus magic damage rides the very next basic attack against the dummy as a grouped on-hit effect; it does not critically strike.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Q/W/E/R's costs are large enough relative to Kha'Zix's level-16 mana pool and regen to stop a cast inside a 15 s fight.
Slows from Unseen Threat and Void Spike, and Void Spike's self-heal, are ignored: crowd control and healing do not affect the damage fight.

assumed.why: assumes Kha'Zix's third evolution point (unlocked at level 16) is spent on Evolved Reaper Claws rather than Void Spike or Wings, since it is the only evolution that changes single-target damage output
